# File systems (VFS)

51 calls. Every request needs the `Authorization` header: see [the overview](../index.md).

## `vfs.list`

```http
GET /namespaces/{namespaceName}/vfs
```

Every VFS of the tenant, or of one namespace with `{ namespace }`.

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=GET%20%2Fnamespaces%2F%7BnamespaceName%7D%2Fvfs).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `namespaceName` | `string` | yes |  |

**Response:** [`VirtualFileSystem`](../types/virtual-file-system.md)`[]` (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X GET "https://api.maitento.com/namespaces/<namespaceName>/vfs" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH"
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
const systems = await mt.vfs.list({ namespace: "support" });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.vfs.list(namespace="demo")
```
<!-- /tabs -->

## `vfs.create`

```http
POST /namespaces/{namespaceName}/vfs
```

Creates a VFS in the namespace.

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=POST%20%2Fnamespaces%2F%7BnamespaceName%7D%2Fvfs).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `namespaceName` | `string` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`VirtualFileSystemCreateRequest`](../types/virtual-file-system-create-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes | The file system's name, under 150 characters. |

**Response:** [`VirtualFileSystem`](../types/virtual-file-system.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X POST "https://api.maitento.com/namespaces/<namespaceName>/vfs" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"..."}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
const vfs = await mt.vfs.create({ name: "notes" }, { namespace: "support" });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.vfs.create("notes", namespace="demo")
```
<!-- /tabs -->

## `vfs.open(name).batchEdit`

```http
POST /namespaces/{namespaceName}/vfs/by-name/{name}/batch/edit
```

Applies edits to several files (optionally all-or-nothing).

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=POST%20%2Fnamespaces%2F%7BnamespaceName%7D%2Fvfs%2Fby-name%2F%7Bname%7D%2Fbatch%2Fedit).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `namespaceName` | `string` | yes |  |
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`BatchEditRequest`](../types/batch-edit-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edits` | [`BatchEditFileRequest`](../types/batch-edit-file-request.md)`[]` |  | List of file edits to apply. |
| `atomic` | `boolean` |  | If true, all edits must succeed or none are applied. If false, each file is edited independently. |

**Response:** [`BatchEditResponse`](../types/batch-edit-response.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X POST "https://api.maitento.com/namespaces/<namespaceName>/vfs/by-name/<name>/batch/edit" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"edits":[],"atomic":false}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
await mt.vfs.open("notes").batchEdit({ edits, atomic: true });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.vfs.open("notes", namespace="demo").batch_edit(edits=[{"path": "/notes/today.md", "operations": [{"type": "replace", "find": "TODO", "replace": "DONE"}]}])
```
<!-- /tabs -->

## `vfs.open(name).batchRead`

```http
POST /namespaces/{namespaceName}/vfs/by-name/{name}/batch/read
```

Reads several files at once.

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=POST%20%2Fnamespaces%2F%7BnamespaceName%7D%2Fvfs%2Fby-name%2F%7Bname%7D%2Fbatch%2Fread).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `namespaceName` | `string` | yes |  |
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`BatchReadRequest`](../types/batch-read-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `paths` | `string[]` |  | Paths to the files to read. |
| `maxLinesPerFile` | `integer` |  | Maximum lines per file (0 = unlimited). Truncates large files. |

**Response:** [`BatchReadResponse`](../types/batch-read-response.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X POST "https://api.maitento.com/namespaces/<namespaceName>/vfs/by-name/<name>/batch/read" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"paths":[],"maxLinesPerFile":0}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
const read = await mt.vfs.open("notes").batchRead({ paths: ["/a.md", "/b.md"], maxLinesPerFile: 200 });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.vfs.open("notes", namespace="demo").batch_read(paths=["/notes/today.md", "/notes/ideas.md"])
```

## `vfs.open(name).appendBytes`

```http
PUT /namespaces/{namespaceName}/vfs/by-name/{name}/files/append/bytes
```

Appends bytes to a file. Never retried.

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=PUT%20%2Fnamespaces%2F%7BnamespaceName%7D%2Fvfs%2Fby-name%2F%7Bname%7D%2Ffiles%2Fappend%2Fbytes).

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `name` | `string` | yes |  |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` |  |  |

**Request body:** [`FileByteContentRequest`](../types/file-byte-content-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | `base64` | yes | The file's bytes, up to 100 MB. May be empty. |

**Response:** [`FileSystemFile`](../types/file-system-file.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X PUT "https://api.maitento.com/namespaces/<namespaceName>/vfs/by-name/<name>/files/append/bytes" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

```


## `vfs.open(name).find`

```http
POST /namespaces/{namespaceName}/vfs/by-name/{name}/find
```

The VFS with this id, or `null`.

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=POST%20%2Fnamespaces%2F%7BnamespaceName%7D%2Fvfs%2Fby-name%2F%7Bname%7D%2Ffind).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `namespaceName` | `string` | yes |  |
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`FindRequest`](../types/find-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` |  | Starting directory path. Defaults to "/" (root). |
| `pattern` | `string \| null` |  | Glob pattern to match files (e.g., "**/*.cs", "src/**/*.ts"). Supports *, **, ?, [abc], {a,b} patterns. |
| `grep` | `string \| null` |  | Search pattern for file contents. If specified, only files containing this pattern are returned. |
| `grepMode` | `string` |  | How to interpret the grep pattern: "literal" (default) or "regex". |
| `ignoreCase` | `boolean` |  | Case-insensitive search for grep. Default false. |
| `contextLines` | `integer` |  | Number of lines before and after each grep match to include as context. |
| `includePreview` | `boolean` |  | If true, include a preview of each file's content (first N lines). |
| `previewLines` | `integer` |  | Number of lines to include in preview. Default 30. |
| `maxResults` | `integer` |  | Maximum number of results to return. Default 100. |
| `maxDepth` | `integer` |  | Maximum recursion depth. Default -1 (unlimited). |
| `type` | `string` |  | Filter by entry type: "file", "directory", or "all". Default "file". |
| `includeHidden` | `boolean` |  | Include hidden files/directories (starting with .). Default false. |

**Response:** [`FindResponse`](../types/find-response.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X POST "https://api.maitento.com/namespaces/<namespaceName>/vfs/by-name/<name>/find" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"path":"...","pattern":"...","grep":"...","grepMode":"...","ignoreCase":false,"contextLines":0,"includePreview":false,"previewLines":0,"maxResults":0,"maxDepth":0,"type":"...","includeHidden":false}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
const found = await mt.vfs.open("notes").find({ path: "/", grep: "Ada" });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.vfs.open("notes", namespace="demo").find(pattern="*.md", grep="TODO")
```
<!-- /tabs -->

## `vfs.openById(id).find`

```http
POST /vfs/by-id/{id}/find
```

The VFS with this id, or `null`.

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=POST%20%2Fvfs%2Fby-id%2F%7Bid%7D%2Ffind).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`FindRequest`](../types/find-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` |  | Starting directory path. Defaults to "/" (root). |
| `pattern` | `string \| null` |  | Glob pattern to match files (e.g., "**/*.cs", "src/**/*.ts"). Supports *, **, ?, [abc], {a,b} patterns. |
| `grep` | `string \| null` |  | Search pattern for file contents. If specified, only files containing this pattern are returned. |
| `grepMode` | `string` |  | How to interpret the grep pattern: "literal" (default) or "regex". |
| `ignoreCase` | `boolean` |  | Case-insensitive search for grep. Default false. |
| `contextLines` | `integer` |  | Number of lines before and after each grep match to include as context. |
| `includePreview` | `boolean` |  | If true, include a preview of each file's content (first N lines). |
| `previewLines` | `integer` |  | Number of lines to include in preview. Default 30. |
| `maxResults` | `integer` |  | Maximum number of results to return. Default 100. |
| `maxDepth` | `integer` |  | Maximum recursion depth. Default -1 (unlimited). |
| `type` | `string` |  | Filter by entry type: "file", "directory", or "all". Default "file". |
| `includeHidden` | `boolean` |  | Include hidden files/directories (starting with .). Default false. |

**Response:** [`FindResponse`](../types/find-response.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X POST "https://api.maitento.com/vfs/by-id/<id>/find" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"path":"...","pattern":"...","grep":"...","grepMode":"...","ignoreCase":false,"contextLines":0,"includePreview":false,"previewLines":0,"maxResults":0,"maxDepth":0,"type":"...","includeHidden":false}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
const found = await mt.vfs.openById("e9d8c7b6-a5f4-4e3d-8c2b-1a0f9e8d7c6b").find({ path: "/", grep: "Ada" });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.vfs.open_by_id("7e8f9a0b-1c2d-4e3f-9a4b-5c6d7e8f9a0b").find(pattern="*.md", grep="TODO")
```

```bash title="curl"
curl -X POST "https://api.maitento.com/vfs/by-id/<id>/tree" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"path":"...","maxDepth":0,"includeFiles":false,"includeHidden":false,"pattern":"..."}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
const tree = await mt.vfs.openById("e9d8c7b6-a5f4-4e3d-8c2b-1a0f9e8d7c6b").tree({ path: "/", maxDepth: 3 });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.vfs.open_by_id("7e8f9a0b-1c2d-4e3f-9a4b-5c6d7e8f9a0b").tree(path="/", max_depth=2)
```
